cases.title: Initiate drag event on draggable product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event capturing the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area to add to cart
cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item into the designated drop area adds it to the cart.

cases.title: Cart display updates correctly upon dropping a product
cases.description: Verify that dropping a product updates the cart display such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding both different and repeated products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding multiple distinct products as well as repeated instances of the same product into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price formatted with currency and two decimal places in allMoney
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements (R-1, R-3, and R-5) have explicit scenario coverage through the provided test cases G-001 through G-005. Each explicitly described operation, state update, and behavior has a corresponding distinct test case. No blockers or missing scenario gaps were found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors: initiating a drag event on a draggable product 'li' element, and capturing the product's title and price for transfer. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors: allowing drag and drop of product items into the designated drop area, automatically updating the cart display (.box2 for title, .box3 for unit price, .box1 for quantity), and supporting both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors: calculating the total price by summing all product prices, formatting the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displaying the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element. No explicit abnormal paths, negative scenarios, or boundaries are mentioned in the requirement text.

Each requirement (R-1, R-3, and R-5) is mapped to appropriate test cases that verify the explicit behaviors described in the text: initiating the drag event, dropping into the designated area, updating the specific cart display elements (.box1, .box2, .box3), handling repeated and different products, and calculating the formatted total price in the #allMoney element.
